additional_info.subject: RE: 0393637 - ID0393637-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP / S5 170003620] Outlet 2 out of order CRM:02023000365
additional_info.body:
Hi,
I was on site this week and checked out the station.
Steps tried:
No1: IP of outlet 1 and 2 swapped
Error flags:
No. 2: The change to the SECC Ip Adress is reversed -> station back in the “original” state.
Then Error Outlet 2 reversed Voltage again
No3: Ip´s of SECC Outlet1 and 2 swapped, LEM IP also swapped
As the reversed voltage true error now also appears on outlet 1, it is clear that the problem must really be with the wiring.
-> Station is opened and wiring checked.
-> Wiring fits according to the instructions.
Nr4: H&S Temp sensor wiring undone again to see if error persists.
The following error flag now appears after reboot
Strange because the LEM can be pinged via switch -XF5!
Reboot again.
LEM read out via Companion:
It still seems to be the “reversedVoltage” error, but it is no longer displayed as such in the error flag. -> not reachable
No5: After rebooting again, everything is suddenly OK?!?!??
No error flags.
No. 6 Since the station appears to be working again, the H&S cabling is restored and restarted.
->After wiring
according to the instructions
, the reverse voltage error appears again -> there must be something wrong with these instructions. I have already checked the wiring 4 times according to the instructions, even measured through. I am 99% sure that it fits.
No 7. Back to original. Switch on, works. No idea why the first attempt to rebuild (No4) didn't work.
Conclusion: The conversion according to H&S temp. sensor wiring cannot be carried out on this station. The problem must be with the wiring or the LEM as the error is also on the right outlet when the IP addresses are swapped.
Can you please read out the LEM again to see if the reversed voltage error occurs. Why is this not displayed as such with the supplied wiring (the wrong one)?
BR
Daniel

Now it is clear that the Error is in the station! The temp rewiring according to the description has already been carried out on another station and there were no problems!
The error is only displayed if rewiring has been performed. Otherwise the LEM also seems to have the error but the station does not recognise it as such.
At the moment the rewiring is reset. Therefore the station is working. However, if you read the LEM from Outlet 2 you will see the voltage error.

Hello Daniel,
I hope this email finds you well.
Following our recent review of both outlets, I would like to confirm that there are no errors detected.
From your explanation, it appears that the error is related to the rewiring process, and once reset, the station is functioning correctly. However, I understand that the voltage error still appears when reading the LEM from Outlet 2.
Based on the logs, I can confirm that successful charging sessions have been carried out without issue on both outlets, and there are no indications of any reverse voltage errors.
Could you please confirm if you consider the issue resolved?
If so, can we now proceed with closing the case?

additional_info.subject: RE: 0393637 - ID0393637-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP / S5 170003620] Outlet 2 out of order CRM:02023000365
additional_info.body:
Hello Ankita,
At the moment there is no fault as I have reversed the wiring so that we don't get any fault messages over the holidays.
As soon as I restore the H&S wiring we will have the error again.
It is not due to the description, nor to the implementation, I think that the fault is really in the LEM. Outlet 1 works as well as the other chargers I have rebuilt.
We can arrange an appointment where I can carry out the H&S wiring on site and you can see live what is happening there.
BR
Daniel

additional_info.subject: RE: 0393637 - ID0393637-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP / S5 170003620] Outlet 2 out of order CRM:02023000365
additional_info.body:
Hello Daniel,
Thank you for the update.
I understand that the wiring has been temporarily reversed to avoid errors.
Kindly correct the wiring as per the charger schematic and check for any errors again.
Additionally, please ensure the following:
LED Status of LEM: Check the LED status of the LEM for Outlet 2 and compare it with the LED status of the LEM for Outlet 1 to identify any discrepancies.
Sensor Unit: Inspect the sensor unit located on top of the charger roof to ensure all connections are properly tightened.
LEM Replacement: If you find that the LEM is faulty, please replace it. We recommend carrying a spare LEM with you when you are on-site to avoid any delays.
MLFB No.
8EM5903-0AA05-2AA7
-BC1.1/ BC2.1 DC Meter 600A ERK DC Meter
These steps should help in identifying the source of the issue.
If you need any assistance during site intervention, please let us know in advance so we can provide the necessary support.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Ankita
